newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed agaisnt key currencies at the end of a rather quiet interbank session on Thursday, dealers said.

"We saw the central (Reserve) bank come into the market some time during the day and they took some money out but the (local) dollar didn't move because we had some large amounts of inflows as well," commented one dealer.

He said the Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. unit, where it also closed on Wednesday, but was quoted easier on sterling at 18.6100/6300 compared to 18.5210/5430, largely due to a weaker U.S. dollar on the British currency overseas.
It was however marginally firmer at 2.5000/5200 from 2.5030/5075 versus the rand and against the mark at 6.5500/5700 compared to 6.5515/5590.
